reviews.text: Been going for years. Groomers are so patient and caring with all my dogs from the little ones to my bigger dogs 🐶🐕 very highly recommended …

I can’t recommend this place enough! They always do such an amazing job with my dog, especially considering she’s a husky and sheds a lot.You can really tell they know and love what they do. The staff is incredibly friendly and treats my dog with so much care and patience, especially knowing she’s a senior. They truly make her feel comfortable and loved every visit and as for me, i know that i don’t have to worry about her when she comes. On top of that, they gave me the sweetest Valentine’s Day picture of her, which meant so much to me considering she’s a senior dog. I 100% recommend them to anyone looking for a groomer who genuinely loves and takes great care of your dog. 🐶💗

Zero stars. I took my pomeranian there on February 2023 to get groomed. I was told they would need to use some sort of razor to get close because his hair was so tangled. When I got him back I was surprised to see he was totally pink. They completely shaved him. I had never owned a pomeranian before but come to find out afterwards YOU ARE NEVER supposed to shave a pomeranian. I assumed they were professionals. It took 1/2 a yr for his fur to grow back in patches. He developed a severe skin allergy clld black skin disease. He will forever need to be on the allergy med Apoquel which is about $100.00 a month. There is no cure. Shaving a pomeranian shocks the hair follicles to the point that they will never allow normal hair growth again. It's been a 1yr and a 1/2 and his hair still has not grown completely back. I regret the day I took him here. He will never be the same.
